{{Quote|There you are, think you can escape me? Think again. I'll finish the job.|Hela-Tan, to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I Journal: Darth Maul">''[[Star Wars Journal: Darth Maul]]''</ref>}}
'''Hela-Tan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] active directly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Hela-Tan was sent to search [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] ship, [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']], after his band of pirates succeeded in surrounding Maul as the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] journeyed to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Maul's mission, as [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] first explained to him, was to to eliminate the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and capture [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] to return her to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where she would be constrained to sign a treaty with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], making its [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] and occupation of the planet "legal". In his run-in with the pirates, Maul escaped his own ship in a small [[Escape pod/Legends|pod]], then evasively infiltrated and [[Darth Maul/Legends#Togorian Pirate attack|attacked]] the occupants of the pirate vessel, killing all on-board including its [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Hela-Tan fought Maul even as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], having at last recovered the ''Scimitar,'' was executing his escape from the remaining pirate assailant to continue towards Tatooine. Hela-Tan succeeded in wounding the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the leg before he himself was sucked into space.
